It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}, and its {{ill|Q712534|lt=former rank}} was {{ill|Son-sha|ja|村社|qid=Q134917284}}. {{nihongo|'''Kawaai Shrine'''|川会神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Shinano Province]].

== Overview ==
The enshrined deity is Sokotsu Watatsumi-no-Mikoto. Located near the confluence of the {{ill|Nōgugawa|Q109361304|qid=Q109361304}} and {{ill|Takase river|Q11671931|qid=Q11671931|lt=Takase River}}, it was repeatedly forced to relocate due to river flooding. Shrine tradition says it was built in Hakuhō 2 ({{ill|673|Q31105|qid=Q31105}}).

In the ''{{ill|Engishiki|Q1342448|qid=Q1342448}}'' ''{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}'', completed in Enchō 5 ({{ill|927|ab|927|af|927|am|927 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|927|ar|927|ary|927|ast|927|avk|927|az|927|azb|۹۲۷ (میلادی)|bar|927|bcl|927|be|927|be_x_old|927|bg|927|bn|৯২৭|bpy|মারি ৯২৭|br|927|bs|927.|ca|927|cdo|927 nièng|ceb|927|ckb|٩٢٧|crh|927|cs|927|csb|927|cv|927|cy|927|da|927|de|927|el|927|eml|927|eo|927|es|927|et|927|eu|927|fa|۹۲۷ (میلادی)|fi|927|fo|927|fr|927|fy|927|ga|927|gan|927年|gd|927|gl|927|he|927|hi|927|hr|927.|ht|927 (almanak jilyen)|hu|927|hy|927|id|927|ilo|927|io|927|is|927|it|927|ja|927年|jv|927|ka|927|kaa|927|kk|927 жыл|ko|927년|la|927|lb|927|lij|927|lmo|927|lt|927 m.|lv|927. gads|map_bms|927|mdf|927|mg|927|mhr|927|mi|927|mk|927|mr|इ.स. ९२७|mrj|927 и|ms|927|mzn|۹۲۷|nah|927|nap|927|nds|927|new|सन् ९२७|nl|927|nn|927|no|927|nrm|927|nso|927|oc|927|or|୯୨୭|os|927-æм аз|pl|927|pnb|927|pt|927|qu|927|ro|927|ru|927 год|rue|927|sa|९२७|scn|927|sd|927ع|se|927|sh|927.|shn|927|si|927|sk|927|smn|927|sq|927|sr|927|su|927|sv|927|sw|927|tg|Соли 927|th|พ.ศ. 1470|tk|927|tl|927|tly|927|tr|927|tt|927 ел|uk|927|ur|927ء|uz|927|vec|927|vi|927|war|927|wuu|927年|xmf|927|zh|927年|zh_min_nan|927 nî|zh_yue|927年|qid=Q30470}}), it is listed as "Kawaai Shrine" in {{ill|Azumi district|Q11450769|qid=Q11450769}}, {{ill|Shinano Province|Q289250|qid=Q289250}}, and ranked as a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}.

It is said to have been moved to the current location in Tenmei 3 ({{ill|1783|Q7745|qid=Q7745}}).

== Precincts ==
Besides the main sanctuary, there are a heiden, worship hall, and gaku-den. A monument to the poet {{ill|Uchiyama Mayumi|Q18336586|qid=Q18336586}} also stands in the precincts.
